L1.title: why f30's window over BMW's panel stays open (MC section 6)
L1.label: arrives

evidence.shape: active cc: number 65535 with no ccList entry for 6842 s at the start of a run (A1)
active cc: number 65535 with no ccList entry for 313 s at the start of a run (A1)
active cc: number 65535 after a message, list at rest for 59367 s (A2)
active cc: number 65535 after a message, list at rest for 11749 s (A2)

why: a number other than 0 with the list at rest for longer than 1 s is a hang; shorter is the order effect (row 5), not a hang
1 short 'number without a list entry' stretches (at most 1 s) were the order effect and are not counted as hangs
